fusions.name: Herd Trample
fusions.desc: The herd crosses the meadow around you, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, every ally deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds. You restore 12 health.

fusions.name: Clover Bolus
fusions.desc: Lobs a chewed wad of clover that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 15% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Hayloft Warmth
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds and fights with 1 more power while it holds. You restore 10 health.

fusions.name: Winter Fodder
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 35%, you regain 5 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.
